# Plan Projections

> > Plan Projections provides Excel-based financial templates, industry-specific revenue models, and calculators to help entrepreneurs and businesses build accurate 5-year financial projections and business plans.

Plan Projections is a comprehensive financial planning resource offering ready-made Excel templates for various business types, from hospitality and retail to SaaS, along with interactive calculators for revenue forecasting, valuation, and market sizing. The platform serves startups and established businesses seeking data-driven financial projections for business planning and investor presentations.

## Key Topics

- Financial Projections Template
- Excel templates
- 5-year forecast
- Revenue projection
- Business planning
- Industry-specific models
- SaaS revenue model
- Startup financial planning
- Sales forecasting
- Business valuation
- Financial statements
- Revenue estimation
- Spreadsheet templates
- Market sizing
- Break-even analysis

## Core Templates & Tools

- [Financial Projections Template Excel](https://www.planprojections.com/financial-projections-template): Main 5-year financial projections Excel template for business planning.
- [Industry Specific Financial Model Templates](https://www.planprojections.com/industry-templates/industry-specific-financial-model-templates): Directory of industry-specific financial model templates.
- [Financial Model Calculators for a Startup](https://www.planprojections.com/calculators/financial-model-calculators-for-a-startup): Suite of financial model calculators for startup planning.

## Hospitality & Service Industry Templates

- [Restaurant Business Revenue Projection](https://www.planprojections.com/industry-templates/restaurant-business-revenue-projection): Free 5-year restaurant revenue projection Excel template.
- [Hotel Revenue Projection Excel Template](https://www.planprojections.com/industry-templates/hotel-revenue-projection): Hotel revenue projection template with occupancy modeling.
- [Coffee Shop Revenue Projection](https://www.planprojections.com/industry-templates/coffee-shop-revenue-projection): Coffee shop business 5-year revenue projection template.
- [Salon Business Plan Revenue Projection](https://www.planprojections.com/industry-templates/salon-business-plan-revenue-projection): Salon business 5-year revenue projection Excel template.
- [Food Truck Revenue Projection Template](https://www.planprojections.com/industry-templates/food-truck-revenue): Food truck business 5-year revenue projection Excel template.
- [Bed and Breakfast Business Plan Revenue Projection](https://www.planprojections.com/industry-templates/bed-and-breakfast-business-plan-revenue-projection): B&B and Airbnb business 5-year revenue projection template.

## Retail & E-Commerce Templates

- [Retail Store Revenue Projection](https://www.planprojections.com/industry-templates/retail-store-revenue-projection): Retail store 5-year revenue and sales projection template.
- [Website Traffic Estimator](https://www.planprojections.com/industry-templates/website-traffic-estimator): Web-based startup traffic and revenue estimator tool.

## SaaS & Subscription Models

- [Saas Revenue Model](https://www.planprojections.com/industry-templates/saas-revenue-model): SaaS revenue model template with subscription and churn metrics.

## Financial Calculators

- [Revenue Projections Calculator](https://www.planprojections.com/calculators/revenue-projections): Revenue calculator based on units and unit prices.
- [Sales Forecast Spreadsheet Template](https://www.planprojections.com/calculators/sales-forecast-spreadsheet): Sales forecast spreadsheet for financial projections.
- [Business Valuation Calculator for a Startup](https://www.planprojections.com/calculators/business-valuation-calculator): Startup valuation calculator for investment equity analysis.
- [Market Size Calculator](https://www.planprojections.com/calculators/market-size-calculator): Market size and break-even calculator for startups.
- [Days Payable Outstanding Calculator](https://www.planprojections.com/calculators/days-payable-outstanding-calculator): DPO calculator for supplier payment analysis.

## Business Planning Guides

- [Funding Requirements in a Business Plan](https://www.planprojections.com/business-plan/funding-requirements-in-a-business-plan): Guide to funding requirements section in business plans.
